units.rawText: On the outskirts of the Oasis.
units.displayText: On the outskirts of the Oasis.

spans.text: On the outskirts of the Oasis.

units.rawText: Professor! Mr. Okabe!
units.displayText: Professor! Mr. Okabe!

spans.text: Professor! Mr. Okabe!

units.rawText: Persicaria rushes over to us, all fully equipped for battle.
units.displayText: Persicaria rushes over to us, all fully equipped for battle.

spans.text: Persicaria rushes over to us, all fully equipped for battle.

units.rawText: All combat personnel are ready and standing by. We're currently conducting defensive operations.
units.displayText: All combat personnel are ready and standing by. We're currently conducting defensive operations.

spans.text: All combat personnel are ready and standing by. We're currently conducting defensive operations.

units.rawText: However, our scouts report that the number of Entropics is steadily increasing.
units.displayText: However, our scouts report that the number of Entropics is steadily increasing.

spans.text: However, our scouts report that the number of Entropics is steadily increasing.

units.rawText: We didn't receive any news about the Entropics when we spoke with Faith just now.
units.displayText: We didn't receive any news about the Entropics when we spoke with Faith just now.

spans.text: We didn't receive any news about the Entropics when we spoke with Faith just now.

units.rawText: I didn't think they could mount such a large-scale attack in such a short time... Looks like the Entropics are gunning for the Oasis.
units.displayText: I didn't think they could mount such a large-scale attack in such a short time... Looks like the Entropics are gunning for the Oasis.

spans.text: I didn't think they could mount such a large-scale attack in such a short time... Looks like the Entropics are gunning for the Oasis.

units.rawText: It was like this in previous world lines, too... Perhaps this is the convergent result of this world line.
units.displayText: It was like this in previous world lines, too... Perhaps this is the convergent result of this world line.

spans.text: It was like this in previous world lines, too... Perhaps this is the convergent result of this world line.

units.rawText: Okabe, have you fought these Entropics before in previous world lines? Did you learn anything useful from it?
units.displayText: Okabe, have you fought these Entropics before in previous world lines? Did you learn anything useful from it?

spans.text: Okabe, have you fought these Entropics before in previous world lines? Did you learn anything useful from it?

units.rawText: In the previous world lines, it was an Entropized Riko that led them, but Riko wasn't Entropized in this world line. Therefore...
units.displayText: In the previous world lines, it was an Entropized Riko that led them, but Riko wasn't Entropized in this world line. Therefore...

spans.text: In the previous world lines, it was an Entropized Riko that led them, but Riko wasn't Entropized in this world line. Therefore...

units.rawText: ...Therefore, someone else is behind this attack.
units.displayText: ...Therefore, someone else is behind this attack.

spans.text: ...Therefore, someone else is behind this attack.

units.rawText: The Professor worriedly looks at the hordes beyond the Sandbox Barrier, and my eyes follow their gaze. This is not the first time I've set foot on the battlefield, but I can't help but feel a sense of silent dread as I see these purple creatures spewing their slime everywhere.
units.displayText: The Professor worriedly looks at the hordes beyond the Sandbox Barrier, and my eyes follow their gaze. This is not the first time I've set foot on the battlefield, but I can't help but feel a sense of silent dread as I see these purple creatures spewing their slime everywhere.

spans.text: The Professor worriedly looks at the hordes beyond the Sandbox Barrier, and my eyes follow their gaze. This is not the first time I've set foot on the battlefield, but I can't help but feel a sense of silent dread as I see these purple creatures spewing their slime everywhere.

units.rawText: However, just like all those times I've faced them in the past, this is not the time to be afraid; I have other things that I need to do.
units.displayText: However, just like all those times I've faced them in the past, this is not the time to be afraid; I have other things that I need to do.

spans.text: However, just like all those times I've faced them in the past, this is not the time to be afraid; I have other things that I need to do.

units.rawText: <size=60>Kukuku... Mu—hahahahaha!</size>
units.displayText: Kukuku... Mu—hahahahaha!

spans.text: Kukuku... Mu—hahahahaha!

units.rawText: My laughter echoes through the battlefield and everyone stares at me in surprise.
units.displayText: My laughter echoes through the battlefield and everyone stares at me in surprise.

spans.text: My laughter echoes through the battlefield and everyone stares at me in surprise.

units.rawText: Looks like it's time to undo the seal on my right hand!
units.displayText: Looks like it's time to undo the seal on my right hand!

spans.text: Looks like it's time to undo the seal on my right hand!

units.rawText: O comrade of mine, do not fear! As long as I, the "insane mad scientist" am here, our victory is a done deal!
units.displayText: O comrade of mine, do not fear! As long as I, the "insane mad scientist" am here, our victory is a done deal!

spans.text: O comrade of mine, do not fear! As long as I, the "insane mad scientist" am here, our victory is a done deal!

units.rawText: But Mr. Okabe, this is your first time in combat...
units.displayText: But Mr. Okabe, this is your first time in combat...

spans.text: But Mr. Okabe, this is your first time in combat...

units.rawText: Hehe, Catgirl No. 2, the instincts of battle have been carved into my body! Ahhh, it's so hard to resist the urge to shed blood; let me at them already!
units.displayText: Hehe, Catgirl No. 2, the instincts of battle have been carved into my body! Ahhh, it's so hard to resist the urge to shed blood; let me at them already!

spans.text: Hehe, Catgirl No. 2, the instincts of battle have been carved into my body! Ahhh, it's so hard to resist the urge to shed blood; let me at them already!

units.rawText: Er... Are you okay? Do you need a doctor...
units.displayText: Er... Are you okay? Do you need a doctor...

spans.text: Er... Are you okay? Do you need a doctor...

units.rawText: Haha, it's alright, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Haha, it's alright, Persicaria.

spans.text: Haha, it's alright, Persicaria.

units.rawText: The Professor chuckles and waves her concerns aside—such is their composure; truly they are my comrade!
units.displayText: The Professor chuckles and waves her concerns aside—such is their composure; truly they are my comrade!

spans.text: The Professor chuckles and waves her concerns aside—such is their composure; truly they are my comrade!

units.rawText: It's just like Okabe said, he's fought many times in other world lines. I'm sure he's a seasoned warrior by now.
units.displayText: It's just like Okabe said, he's fought many times in other world lines. I'm sure he's a seasoned warrior by now.

spans.text: It's just like Okabe said, he's fought many times in other world lines. I'm sure he's a seasoned warrior by now.

units.rawText: If Okabe is this confident, then we have no reason to fall back.
units.displayText: If Okabe is this confident, then we have no reason to fall back.

spans.text: If Okabe is this confident, then we have no reason to fall back.

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=40>Then let us once again show them the coordination with which we faced Ragnarok together, my comrade!</size></color>
units.displayText: Then let us once again show them the coordination with which we faced Ragnarok together, my comrade!

spans.text: Then let us once again show them the coordination with which we faced Ragnarok together, my comrade!
